headline: Ratchet & Clank replaces raw offsets with shared structures and readable names
summary: A broad source cleanup replaces private object, hero, controller, vector and camera views with shared structures (#125). About 6,200 symbols and 334 hero fields gain names, and level files are renamed by their contents. The pull request says the PAL build remains byte-identical and US, PAL v1.00 and Japanese version checks are unchanged. The large line totals come from rewriting existing source, rather than new game features.
